race.title: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap Chase (0-100)
race.verdict: WESTERN MODEL 's latest Sligo third came in a race which has worked out really well and he's taken to open his chase account now. Il Silenzio has a solid chase record and is second choice ahead of recent Sligo hurdle winner Moorish Castle , who appeals as one likely to take to fences. WESTERN MODEL (IRE) IL SILENZIO MOORISH CASTLE (IRE)
